decisions.reason: The condenser was promoted to its own page in 2024, a sign of growing commitment, and it sits close to the core offer, so keeping the option open costs little while its value is still emerging.

Like B, it moved up to a dedicated page and shares core technology and production with the established offer, so the carrying cost is low and the signals point toward realization rather than resolution against it.
The tube liner supports the firm's strategic lifecycle-service business; demand for repairing corroded tubes is still uncertain but plausible, and keeping it listed costs little.
The customized air cooler line fits the firm's integrated-solution strategy and relies on existing engineering, so keeping it is cheap and its option value remains.

The tube-end repair inserts are a low-cost service add-on whose uptake is still unresolved, and nothing yet shows they cannot pay off, so holding the option is justified despite the firm's many other projects.
